title: Enhanced removal of crystal violet from aqueous solutions using BaTiO3@ZnO: isotherm, kinetic, and thermodynamic evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09495J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmed Barakat, Magdi E. Khalifa, A. M. Abdelghany, Wael I. Mortada
Mesoporous BaTiO3@ZnO synthesized via a solid-state method exhibited high adsorption efficiency for crystal violet in aqueous media, achieving a adsorption capacity of 97.84 mg g−1 and demonstrating its promise for industrial wastewater treatment.
